prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: exactly one compact square game status icon for a persistent combat buff counter

Consumer contract:
The icon represents a global drain-percentage bonus that persists for the entire combat and can stack without limit. It is shown both as a normal power icon and as a larger inspection icon, with the same artwork scaled down to 64 and 32 pixels.

Primary request:
Create exactly one centered magical emblem: a crisp purple-and-gold infinity ring orbiting one luminous cyan-blue life crystal at its center. Place several discrete sharp attack-star shards along the ring, all visibly flowing back toward the central life crystal. The returning shards make the crystal brighter, clearly communicating repeated attack energy converted into lasting recovery and endlessly increasing drain percentage.

Style and material:
Polished fantasy card-game UI icon, clean anime magical-girl design language, faceted gemstone core, precise gilded geometry, saturated violet and indigo enamel, cyan-blue life light, strong readable silhouette, controlled internal highlights, high contrast at 32 pixels.

Composition:
One compact connected emblem centered in the canvas. The infinity loop is the dominant silhouette, the life crystal is the unmistakable focal point, and the attack-star shards are few, discrete, and large enough to remain legible when reduced. Generous clear space on every side. Every visible element remains well inside the canvas.

Constraints:
No external halo, bloom, fog, haze, scattered particles, ground shadow, cast shadow, frame, badge plate, second icon, text, letters, numbers, watermark, person, face, mouth, teeth, weapon, blood, blood drop, liquid, vein, tube, tentacle, or organic gore. No red or crimson liquid-like forms. Do not let any element touch a canvas edge.
